description: 한국공항공사_제주공항 국내선 출도착 여객수 학습용 데이터 [airports] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국공항공사. 한국공항공사(Korea Airports Cooperation)는 인천국제공항을 제외한 제주공항 등 전국공항을 운영하는 공공기관(시장형 공기업)입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국공항공사. Its tags are 제주공항 입도객 수, 제주공항 출도객 수, 제주공항 국내선 여객수, 제주공항 출발 여객 수, 제주공항 도착 여객 수. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
